prompt:
REFERENCE ROLE: precise regular3-column by4-row square-cell grid and warm photorealistic style only. Replace all scenes with the twelve new meal contexts below. Final overall canvas MUST have width:height3:4 (0.75), not1:2, and all12 cells must be SQUARE with continuous narrow white dividers.
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: I eat + food / meal + optional time / place / circumstance. Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: I eat lunch at one. Visual staging: An adult having a meal in a natural everyday setting. Specific context: I eat lunch at one. No captions or written speech.
2. Meaning: I eat an apple after school. Visual staging: An adult having a meal in a natural everyday setting. Specific context: I eat an apple after school. No captions or written speech.
3. Meaning: I eat vegetables every day. Visual staging: An adult having a meal in a natural everyday setting. Specific context: I eat vegetables every day. No captions or written speech.
4. Meaning: I eat dinner with my family. Visual staging: An adult having a meal in a natural everyday setting. Specific context: I eat dinner with my family. No captions or written speech.
5. Meaning: I eat eggs for breakfast when I have time to cook. Visual staging: An adult cooking eggs in a morning kitchen.
6. Meaning: I eat a light meal before my evening class. Visual staging: An adult eating a small meal with class books nearby.
7. Meaning: I eat lunch with my colleagues at work. Visual staging: Colleagues sharing lunch in an office break room.
8. Meaning: I eat slowly so that I can enjoy my food. Visual staging: An adult calmly enjoying a meal at a table.
9. Meaning: I eat fruit instead of sweets after lunch. Visual staging: An adult choosing a bowl of fruit beside wrapped sweets.
10. Meaning: I eat at home during the week. Visual staging: An adult serving a home-cooked meal at a kitchen table.
11. Meaning: I eat different vegetables when they are in season. Visual staging: An adult selecting a colorful variety of seasonal vegetables.
12. Meaning: I eat dinner early, but my brother eats after work. Visual staging: An adult eating dinner beside a second place setting waiting for a brother.


Specific staging: Cell1 adult eating a lunchtime meal with analog clock exactly1:00 (minute hand straight up, hour hand slightly clockwise at one), no clock numerals. Cell2 fully clothed adult learner eating an apple after school with school bag nearby. Cell3 adult eating a colorful vegetable meal at home. Cell4 modest Arab family eating a halal evening dinner, women in opaque hijab, men in loose full-length thobes/trousers, children in long opaque clothes. Cell5 adult eating freshly cooked eggs at breakfast, breakfast cooking pan nearby; eating is the main action. Cell6 a small light meal at dusk with class books closed nearby, before evening class. Cell7 ONLY modestly fully clothed same-gender colleagues sharing lunch in an office break room. Cell8 adult calmly eating slowly and enjoying the food. Cell9 adult chooses fruit bowl over a small plate of wrapped sweets, no readable wrappers. Cell10 adult eats a home-cooked meal in a recognizable home kitchen/dining space. Cell11 adult at table with a varied seasonal vegetable plate, no shopping-only scene. Cell12 adult eating an early dinner, second empty place setting and covered portion waiting for brother after work, no split-screen or graphic inset. Warm natural photographic light, ordinary respectful Arab homes and office. All food halal, no pork, wine or alcohol. No readable words, labels, numbers, overlays, bubbles, extra cells or logos. IMPORTANT: equally wide three columns, equally high four rows, square panels, broad3:4 portrait canvas.
